name: Ring of the Favored Archpriest
body:
Aura: moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Slot: ring; Price: 6,000 gp (1st level spell), 12,000 gp (2nd level spell), 17,000 gp (3rd level spell), Weight: —

DESCRIPTION

These rings are identical to a ring of the gifted hierophant, but are usable by clerics with the spontaneous casting ability to exchange a prepared divine spell for a cure or inflict spell of the same level. Each ring allows the spontaneous casting of a single, specific cleric spell from the abjuration, enchantment, conjuration, necromancy or transmutation schools. For example, a 3rd-level ring could be forged to allow a cleric to spontaneously exchange any 3rd-level prepared cleric spell for a daylight spell.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring,; Special creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be spontaneously cast, cure wounds (of the level equal to the spell to be spontaneously cast), plus the specific cleric spell to be spontaneously cast (e.g., daylight, etc.); Cost: 3,000 gp (1st level spell), 6,000 gp (2nd level spell), 8,500 gp (3rd level spell)
